guard.name: prevent_approval_preference_mutation

indexes.name: approval_preferences_complete_key
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX approval_preferences_complete_key ON openbot_internal.approval_preferences USING btree (deployment_id, tenant_id, actor_id, bot_id, target_kind, target_id)

indexes.name: approval_preferences_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX approval_preferences_pkey ON openbot_internal.approval_preferences USING btree (preference_id)

triggers.name: approval_preferences_mutation_guard
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER approval_preferences_mutation_guard BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON openbot_internal.approval_preferences FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION openbot_internal.prevent_approval_preference_mutation()

triggers.name: approval_preferences_no_truncate
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER approval_preferences_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON openbot_internal.approval_preferences FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION openbot_internal.prevent_approval_preference_mutation()

constraints.name: approval_preferences_complete_key
constraints.definition: UNIQUE (deployment_id, tenant_id, actor_id, bot_id, target_kind, target_id)

constraints.name: approval_preferences_identity_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((octet_length(deployment_id) >= 1) AND (octet_length(deployment_id) <= 512)) AND ((deployment_id COLLATE "C") !~ '[--]'::text) AND ((octet_length(tenant_id) >= 1) AND (octet_length(tenant_id) <= 512)) AND ((tenant_id COLLATE "C") !~ '[--]'::text) AND ((octet_length(actor_id) >= 1) AND (octet_length(actor_id) <= 512)) AND ((actor_id COLLATE "C") !~ '[--]'::text) AND ((octet_length(bot_id) >= 1) AND (octet_length(bot_id) <= 512)) AND ((bot_id COLLATE "C") !~ '[--]'::text) AND ((octet_length(target_id) >= 1) AND (octet_length(target_id) <= 512)) AND ((target_id COLLATE "C") !~ '[--]'::text)))

constraints.name: approval_preferences_target_identity
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((target_kind = 'memory_user'::text) AND (target_id = actor_id)) OR ((target_kind = 'memory_bot'::text) AND (target_id = bot_id)) OR (target_kind = 'memory_thread'::text)))
